🛡️ Tool 1: ASB Scraper & Reference Set

Scrapes official Android Security Bulletins and OSV database feeds to build a labeled reference dataset. Uses Google Gemini to analyze CVE descriptions and generate plain-English explanations of technical vulnerabilities.

View January 2024 Bulletin
⚡ Tool 2: Android Fuzzer & LLM Classifier

Fuzzes modern Android builds (Android 14/15) via malformed Intents, Binder IPC, and system services. Extracts crash logs, computes deterministic Crash IDs, and uses Gemini to classify bugs against the ASB reference set and explain root causes.
